mensagens.input: You visited a friend on Planet Saturn. Saturn rotates faster than Planet Earth, making a day on Saturn shorter than a day on Earth. After 24 days passed on Saturn, you returned home to find that only 10 days had passed on Earth. This time, your friend will be visiting earth by himself, but he must come back before 12 Saturn days have passed. How long can he stay on Earth before his time runs out?
Your friend can stay on earth for _____ Earth days.
